data.narrative:
Quindar is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $27.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs—a broad set reflecting the heterogeneity of the sector.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $27.3M raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, implying $55M. Peer-median anchoring across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comps yields a median valuation of $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B; this cohort includes Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B, Seed). Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied—the sector median P/S across the 6 public comps is 25.3x, but Quindar's revenue is not on file, precluding this calculation.

Triangulation across the two applicable methods supports a range of $46M to $1.5B, with a median of $677M. The wide dispersion reflects tension between stage-progression (floor) and peer comps (ceiling). Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 3-peer set for Quindar's specific product-market position and the revenue trajectory assumptions embedded in peer valuations. Further clarity on Quindar's commercial traction and market segment would narrow this range substantially.
